messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout r-5487 -> model: redwood-v2.3.1, target 10% traffic (canary). Regions: us-west1, us-east1. Change window 16:00-18:00 UTC. Release notes: https://releases/redwood/v2.3.1 (TL;DR: quantization tweak, kv-cache prewarm, tokenizer patch). Reply STOP to pause, otherwise ACK for go.

deploy-bot: health snapshot (initial): errors: 0.3% (baseline 0.2%), 95p latency +38ms vs baseline, embed-diff: 0.4% drift. warmup: kvcache hit-rate 62% (expected 85%) on canary nodes.

Anika: Oof kvcache warmup low — was prewarm hook executed for canary pool?

Lia: saw a handful of first-token 5xx from the new variant during heat-up. paste logs: `rpc: SetKVCache failed: oom when allocating 64MB` (3 events).

Sam: I'm seeing 95p latency jump in us-west, dashboards: `p95 120ms -> 165ms` since the shift. not catastrophic but notable.

Infra: prewarm script ran, but some older nodes didn't pick the new artifact due to a transient registry 503. we're rolling a quick fix to re-trigger prewarm on affected instances.

Priya (product): Quick ask — hold until the eval harness finishes the 200-sample quality set (should be ~12m). product wants to ensure f1 on structured extraction doesn't regress.

Anika: eval finished early, flagged format-regression on 12/200 prompts. metric: structured_f1 -2.1% vs baseline. I'll post a diff in a sec. :stop_sign:

Lia: +1 stop — the kvcache OOMs could explain the format hits if tokens truncated mid-output.

Marcus (ops): Noted. Two stop votes so far. Requesting quick triage: can Infra re-run prewarm and re-check kv usage before we decide rollback? we can hold traffic at 10% during investigation.

Infra: re-triggered prewarm on affected canary nodes at 16:07 UTC. new kv hit-rate now 81% on restarted nodes. still ~65% cluster-wide. ramping another wave of warm threads.

Sam: latency trending back down to baseline in us-east, us-west still ~20ms above baseline.

Priya (product): product vote: GO if format/regression is explained by warmup and we can confirm no semantic regressions on the full eval set. otherwise STOP. holding my vote.

Anika: I'm voting STOP for now. 12/200 structured failures + OOMs = risk for live traffic.

deploy-bot: Canary paused by user vote. Current state: 10% paused. Votes recorded: STOP: Anika, Lia; HOLD/Need more data: Priya (product), Marcus (ops); GO: none. Rollback not yet executed.

Marcus (ops): Proposal: keep traffic pinned at 10%, do a 20m investigation window — if warmup failures drop to <1 event and structured_f1 delta <1%, auto-resume. If not, roll back regionally to redwood-v2.3.0 for affected regions.

Infra: Agree with Marcus. We can also pin traffic routing to exclude new nodes in eu-west if needed — but this rollout only in us-west/us-east.

Sam: I'll watch latency and error logs. If p95 exceeds +60ms or 5xx rate >0.5% we'll trigger immediate rollback.

Anika: If we do rollback, prefer regional pin (us-west only) to reduce blast radius.

Priya (product): Running extended eval now (1k samples) to validate the hypothesis about partial warmup causing format drops. ETA ~18m.

Marcus (ops): Decision: hold for 20 minutes, no immediate rollback. Infra to push full prewarm wave and then we re-evaluate. If negative signals persist at 16:28 UTC rollback plan auto-triggers unless a human overrides.

deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Hold timer started (20m). Will auto-evaluate at 5487654339 and notify. Please continue to post observations in this thread. :thumbsup:

Lia: thx. running a quick grep for OOMs across canary nodes and will post counts.

Anika: thanks — tagging infra and ops. please surface any nodes that still show the registry 503 event so we can re-image if needed.

Infra: found 3 nodes with stale artifact state, re-imaging now. estimated done by +6m.

Sam: monitoring dashboard updated. will escalate if any threshold hit.

deploy-bot: update: hold window ends at 5487654339 (20m). Current last_message_ts set to 5487654338 to reflect latest chat.

Priya (product): FYI evaluated 1k set halfway: structured_f1 delta now -0.7% (improving). will post final numbers in ~7m.

Marcus (ops): standing by. if anything changes call me on pager.
